title: Aurora Networks Named Video Experience Leader in The Fast Mode
summary: November 3 2026 Richardson TX - Aurora Networks has been recognized by The Fast Mode Awards 2026 receiving the Video Experience Leader for Impact award.
body_markdown:
**November, 3 2026** – Richardson TX - Aurora Networks has been recognized by The Fast Mode Awards 2026, receiving the Video Experience Leader for Impact award.


The Fast Mode Awards recognize organizations and individuals helping shape the future of connectivity and digital infrastructure. The 2026 program evaluates initiatives across four core pillars: Excellence, Impact, Innovation and Growth, with entries assessed by an independent expert review panel of industry leaders and analysts.


“We’re proud to be recognized by The Fast Mode as a Video Experience Leader for Impact,” said Chris Brown, VP, Global Video Systems, Aurora Networks. “Video remains a critical part of what service providers offer to subscribers today, but the way audiences consume content continues to evolve rapidly. Our focus is on helping operators adapt to that change, simplify their video operations and get more value from their existing and future technology investments.”


Aurora Networks helps operators evolve their video environments to meet changing consumer expectations while addressing the operational and economic realities of delivering video at scale. By enabling more flexible, efficient approaches to video delivery and monetization, Aurora Networks helps service providers modernize at their own pace while continuing to deliver high-quality experiences to subscribers.


The award builds on Aurora Networks’ broader commitment to giving operators practical paths to network and service modernization, helping them introduce new capabilities while protecting existing investments and minimizing operational disruption.


The 2026 winners were announced by The Fast Mode on November 3. The awards are described by the organizer as an independent recognition program honoring companies and individuals redefining digital connectivity. For the complete list of winners, visit The Fast Mode Awards 2026 winners.
